jobs.description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise. Abschluss: Deine Bachelorarbeit schreibst du zu einem Thema aus unserer Praxis. Dauer: 7 Semester (3,5 Jahre) – ohne Verlängerung der Regelstudienzeit. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.  Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital. The role, in a nutshell: At Chainguard we re focused on securing the software supply chain, and we re building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. We re looking for an engineering manager to lead a fast-moving team shipping tools that developers will actually use — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and new products built on our microVM sandbox platform.   You ll own these products end-to-end: hire and grow the team, set the roadmap with Product, and stay hands-on enough to dig into the code. This is a high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, takes initiative, and measures success by what ships and who uses it. What you ll do: Own a portfolio of products end-to-end — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and emerging microVM-based products — from roadmap through implementation, rollout, and iteration. Hire, lead, and grow a small team of strong engineers. Remove blockers and create the conditions for them to do their best work. Stay technically hands-on: review designs and PRs, prototype when it unblocks the team, and unblock the team Partner closely with Product on a roadmap with real deadlines — help the team prioritize tradeoffs and ship iteratively rather than waiting for perfect. jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (French-speaking)
jobs.description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms. About the Team We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team , which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling. In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time. You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations . You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise

jobs.title: Operational Safety Advisor
jobs.description: At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade. Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now. Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement. Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway. The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work. The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it. The role We are looking for a pragmatic, field-oriented Operational Safety Advisor whose mission is to enable safe, efficient and repeatable deployments of autonomous industrial machines. Working within the Deployment team, you will help customers and Deployment Managers identify operational risks early, agree practical mitigations and remove blockers. Your role is to simplify how safety is addressed, not add bureaucracy, complexity or new approval gates. Key responsibilities Site visits and operational assessments Visit customer sites to understand working practices, machine movements, pedestrian interfaces, traffic management, visibility and exclusion zones. Identify operational risks early and work with customers and Deployment Managers to propose proportionate, practical actions that keep deployments moving safely. Support early site feasibility (pre / post contract signing) and readiness discussions, using existing deployment milestones rather than creating additional approval stages. jobs.description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions. As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Act as the technical authority for the end-to-end signal processing and inference chain for CoMind’s technologies: from raw optical data through to clinical measurements Set the methodological direction for estimation, signal extraction and ML modelling across the team: which approaches suit which problems, how they are evaluated, and what evidence is required before a method is trusted. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Product Engineer Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice . We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. About the Role This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! Pourquoi on recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer ? Nos clients ont des systèmes legacy critiques, parfois vieux de 20 ans. Ils veulent les moderniser vite, sans casser ce qui marche. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA. Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production. Ton équipe : Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Tu travailles avec un AI Architect, un Tech Lead, des Software Engineers et un Product Manager, et tu t'appuies sur une communauté tech de plus de 350 The

jobs.description: The Mission: Strategic Growth & Deep-Tech Advisory (Telecom Focus) At Illuin Technology, we don't just "sell" software; we architect the AI future of the world’s largest organizations. As a Senior Account Executive specialized in Telecommunications, your mission is to manage a strategic portfolio of 5 to 10 major enterprise accounts within the Telco sector. You aren't just a vendor; you are a trusted advisor navigating high-stakes environments to deliver durable, multi-year partnerships with Tier-1 operators, ISPs, and infrastructure providers. You will master a dual-track revenue model: driving multi-year licenses for our cutting-edge AI product suite while orchestrating high-impact strategic consulting projects. Your success is measured by your ability to penetrate complex telecom organizations, build C-Level intimacy, and turn technical excellence into sustainable commercial success. Your DNA The Telco Strategic Hunter: You thrive in the complexity of long sales cycles (6–12 months) specific to the telecommunications industry. You don't just wait for leads; you build account plans that map out stakeholders and influence the RFP (Appel d'Offres) before it’s even written. You have successfully answered and won major Telco RFPs in the past. Industry Insider: You possess a profound understanding of the Telco landscape. You know the specific challenges of the sector—from 5G monetization and network optimization to OSS/BSS modernization and customer churn reduction—and you know how to leverage AI to address them. Hybrid Commercial Profile: You are equally at home selling scalable SaaS products as you are selling high-value, bespoke strategic services (Time & Materials (T&M) and Fixed-price). AI Fluent: You possess a deep cognitive curiosity for AI and IT architecture. You can hold your own in a room of Telco CTOs, CIOs, and Data Leads, translating technical capabilities into tangible business ROI. jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site. Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures. Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot. Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it. jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Dit is jouw uitdaging Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden: Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen. Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken. Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? jobs.description: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou! Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt. Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡ Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider. jobs.description: At Graviton, we don t believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you ll work on those questions every day. You ll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. jobs.description: The Opportunity This isn’t just a Sales Development role — it’s your chance to be the engine of Sitetracker’s pipeline growth during a high-impact period. As a French-speaking Senior Sales Development Representative, you’ll address the critical business need of generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline in our EMEA region. With increased investment and focus on international expansion, your efforts will directly influence revenue growth and market penetration in this dynamic, fast-paced environment. You’ll be stepping into a role with visibility, autonomy, and the support to shape how Sitetracker connects with prospective customers across London, Spain, and beyond. If you’re driven by the challenge of building scalable outbound strategies and crave the opportunity to make a measurable difference — this is it. What You’ll Do As a Senior SDR, you’ll play a pivotal front-line role in Sitetracker’s sales ecosystem. You’ll consistently generate high-quality leads and pipeline through thoughtful, targeted outreach, becoming a true partner to our account executives and a trusted voice to our prospects. This isn’t a “smile and dial” environment — it’s a career-defining opportunity to take ownership of your region and make strategic decisions about where and how we go to market. You’ll collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine messaging, run account-based plays, and experiment with new channels and approaches. Your success will be measured not just by volume, but by the business value of the opportunities you surface. In short, you won’t just be booking meetings — you’ll be driving real, scalable impact. jobs.description: Level Up Your Career! At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space. At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5. Join The Team! Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break. We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters. This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games, and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight. This role is based on-site 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. What You’ll Do: Steer portfolio UA. Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest. Grow a brilliant team. jobs.title: Merchandise Planning & Analytics Analyst
jobs.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. LONDON Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events. COMMERICAL We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact. THE ROLE The Merchandise Planning & Analytics team supports the growth of key supply channels and brand partnerships on FARFETCH through commercial planning and data-driven insights. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? About the Role You'll be our marketplace economics expert, using advanced analytics and causal inference to tackle our biggest strategic questions. Where will growth come from next? How does competition shape our pricing? Which incentives unlock more supply? How do inventory levels affect customer experience? Your insights will directly influence decisions across our Supply and Pricing teams, helping shape how we operate in markets around the world. Lead cross-functional projects with Supply, Pricing, Business and Engineering teams. Establish best practices for causal inference, experimentation and impact measurement , and mentor other analysts. Communicate complex analytical work clearly to senior stakeholders and influence commercial decisions. jobs.title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
jobs.description: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. Les missions pourront comprendre : •Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set). •Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques. •L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal. Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 What keeps us up at night We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale . You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise . Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world , while delivering an outstanding conversational experience . Things we’re working on: 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question.
